notes: 0.3.54（纯性能，行为不变）：①capture 判断文件要不要重写，从「每个文件算两次哈希」改成「批量 FileInfo 比对（大小+修改时间），只对可疑文件算哈希」，五万文件从约 120 秒降到约 4 秒，加 -DeepVerify 可强制全量算哈希；②推送前的历史超限扫描改为按提交缓存，只首扫/被拒/-ScanHistory 时全量跑，五万文件仓库每次省下 20 秒以上；③拉取由 fetch+pull（两次网络往返）改为 fetch+merge --ff-only（一次往返）。
notesEn: 0.3.54 (performance only, behaviour unchanged): capture no longer hashes every file twice to decide whether a file needs rewriting — it compares batched FileInfo (size + mtime) and hashes only the suspicious ones, cutting ~120 s to ~4 s on 50k files; -DeepVerify forces a full hash pass. The pre-push oversized-history scan is now cached per commit and only runs in full on the first push, after a rejection, or with -ScanHistory, saving 20 s+ per push on a 50k-file repo. A pull is now fetch + merge --ff-only (one network round trip) instead of fetch + pull (two).
